@@U04578@@
Come on, you shambling gaggle of misbegotten, half-alive lemurs!

@@U04580@@
(In chorus.)

@@U04581@@
Here we are at your command; We've half heard why we came. It Is all about a stretch of land, And we are here to claim it. Stakes sharp pointed we have here, Long chains to measure sections. But why you called us, sir, we fear, Has fled our recollections.

@@U04583@@
This job will need no artist. Use yourselves as measuring rods. The tallest of you stretch out on the grass, the rest mark out his shape, then dig a hole, long and deep, the same as was done for our forebears. From palace to narrow abode; it always arrives at the same stupid ending.

@@U04585@@
(Digging away with mocking gestures.)

@@U04586@@
In youth when I did live, did love, I thought it very sweet; Where mirth was free, and jollity, That place for me was meet. But old Age with his stealing steps Clawed me with his crutch. I stumbled, tumbled in the grave Why must they open such?

@@U04587@@
(Enter 浮士德 from the palace, groping along the doorposts.)
translation:
@@U04578@@
来吧，你们这群步履蹒跚、半死不活的私生子狐猴！

@@U04580@@
（齐声）

@@U04581@@
我们听从您的指挥；我们来的原因已经听了一半了。这都是关于一片土地的，而我们来这里是为了夺取它。我们这里有尖锐的木桩，测量截面的长链。但我们担心，先生，您为何打电话给我们，我们已不记得了。

@@U04583@@
这项工作不需要艺术家。用你自己作为测量杆。你们中最高的人在草地上伸展身体，其余的人画出自己的形状，然后挖一个又长又深的洞，就像我们的祖先所做的那样。从宫殿到狭窄的住所；它总是到达同样愚蠢的结局。

@@U04585@@
（用嘲笑的手势挖下去。）

@@U04586@@
年轻的时候，我活过，爱过，我觉得很甜蜜；那里有自由的欢笑和欢乐， 那个地方对我来说是满足的。但年老的脚步却偷偷地用他的拐杖抓着我。我跌跌撞撞，跌倒在坟墓里 为什么他们一定要这样打开？

@@U04587@@
（浮士德从宫中上，摸索着门柱。）
